---
title: "1. Define the question: Your own study"
---

## Your question

::: {.callout-note}
How do community composition, Shannon diversity, and count totals differ between my sample groups?
:::

Use the same steps with your prepared study tables. Adapt the question to name a comparison supported by your metadata.

## Your dataset

Prepare your three tidy TSV files in `data/my-study/`. This folder is reserved for your inputs and may be empty or absent until you create it.

| Location | Folder |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `data/my-study/` |
| Outputs | `results/my-study/` |

## Your task

Follow the seven steps in order: define the question, preview results, meet the inputs, check them, run the analysis, explain the evidence, and write the report. Complete workspace setup before starting.

[Next: Preview the results](01-see-the-result.qmd)
